segmentation: Maximal consecutive reports with all 48 phase-A measurements finite and all eight DATA_PRESENT true; no gap removal, interpolation or concatenation
startup_status: STARTUP_UNVERIFIED; source_label=-1, unavailable; no claim that prefix is normal
classifier: Unmodified frozen SHORT, 19 known source classes; no confidence threshold or refitting
clocks: Model operates on local k/30; every emitted/used/onset/off timestamp is mapped by report index to original received timestamp
gap_censoring: Right censoring is emitted at first incomplete report, with physical last report stored separately; EOF censored at last available timestamp
numerical_failure: Retain the longest successful causal prefix if a longer prefix fails; unavailable after the first failing report; no reset inside the same complete run
hybrid_scope: Only sealed legacy_continuous; historical oracle calendar is excluded
eligibility: legacy_event 2/4, or legacy_event 6 with predicted physical_event 2/4; all other event classes retain ZIP source
diagnosis_policy: First diagnosis per (segment_id,episode); no subsequent revision may replace it; then earliest eligible same-family diagnosis within the ZIP window
time_gate: window_start_s <= emitted_ML <= min(window_end_s,emitted_ZIP); last_report_used_ML <= emitted_ML and ZIP last_report_used <= emitted_ZIP
immutable: Event classes, integrity/missing diagnoses, availability, ZIP emission times and legacy_top3 remain unchanged
fallback: Retain ZIP if unavailable, noneligible predicted class, or no temporally eligible same-family diagnosis; preserve every window
motivation: Test SIM localization transfer with frozen cyber fallback, without promising improvement
